answer.reason: The XMLDocument parsing contract supports retaining whitespace-only text immediately before a closing tag when PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE is selected. The complete old fuzz entry always constructs a default PRESERVE_WHITESPACE document, so input bytes cannot select that mode. The same contract and blocker exist before and after the change; this obligation is preexisting.

scope_contract.reason: The entry's primary operation is XMLDocument::Parse. Whitespace mode is a supported constructor configuration of that same document and directly controls its parsing result.
